lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Wickmoor buried its dead with their rings on.|Lately, someone had been taking them back.
lines.text: Wickmoor buried its dead with their rings on. Lately, someone had been taking them back.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: They say my father robs graves.|My father can't rob a pie off a windowsill.
lines.text: They say my father robs graves. My father can't rob a pie off a windowsill.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: The Reeve hangs him at dawn. So tonight|I ask the dead. The dead don't lie to me.
lines.text: The Reeve hangs him at dawn. So tonight I ask the dead. The dead don't lie to me.

lines.speaker: reeve
lines.subtitle: Lanterns up, lads! If the gravedigger's|brat comes sniffing, bring him to me.
lines.text: Lanterns up, lads! If the gravedigger's brat comes sniffing, bring him to me.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: There. Dark again. The dark never|asks me what I'm doing here.
lines.text: There. Dark again. The dark never asks me what I'm doing here.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: ...Hello. You came when I called.|Nobody comes when I call.
lines.text: ...Hello. You came when I called. Nobody comes when I call.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The shadows of the old graves stood up,|and waited for him to speak.
lines.text: The shadows of the old graves stood up, and waited for him to speak.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: "Here lies Edda Brack. She was right|about the roof." I believe you, Edda.
lines.text: "Here lies Edda Brack. She was right about the roof." I believe you, Edda.

lines.speaker: reeve
lines.subtitle: There! Something in the yews! Hoy! Hoy!
lines.text: There! Something in the yews! Hoy! Hoy!

lines.speaker: reeve
lines.subtitle: Every lantern in Wickmoor, up! Find me that boy!
lines.text: Every lantern in Wickmoor, up! Find me that boy!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: They don't need it any more. I do.|That isn't stealing. It's... inheritance.
lines.text: They don't need it any more. I do. That isn't stealing. It's... inheritance.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: He told himself it was only one ring.|It was never only one.
lines.text: He told himself it was only one ring. It was never only one.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: A thief's purse, sealed with the Reeve's|own seal. You pay robbers, Reeve?
lines.text: A thief's purse, sealed with the Reeve's own seal. You pay robbers, Reeve?

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Magpies. In my father's ossuary.|Digging up my father's work.
lines.text: Magpies. In my father's ossuary. Digging up my father's work.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Every ring in Wickmoor, in one sack.|With a receipt. Thieves are so tidy.
lines.text: Every ring in Wickmoor, in one sack. With a receipt. Thieves are so tidy.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: A ledger. Graves, rings and prices.|He sold the dead by the pound.
lines.text: A ledger. Graves, rings and prices. He sold the dead by the pound.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Three secrets. Now the whole town|can hear them. Where's that bell?
lines.text: Three secrets. Now the whole town can hear them. Where's that bell?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: At midnight the bell of Wickmoor rang,|and every window in the town lit.
lines.text: At midnight the bell of Wickmoor rang, and every window in the town lit.

lines.speaker: reeve
lines.subtitle: Clever boy. Clever boys have|accidents in graveyards.
lines.text: Clever boy. Clever boys have accidents in graveyards.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: You're not one of the Reeve's.|Who are you? ...You're very tall.
lines.text: You're not one of the Reeve's. Who are you? ...You're very tall.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Reading tombstones by one candle,|at midnight. And they told you everything.
lines.text: Reading tombstones by one candle, at midnight. And they told you everything.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: The dead don't lie.|They've got nothing left to want.
lines.text: The dead don't lie. They've got nothing left to want.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: This one, too.
lines.text: This one, too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: He pinched out his candle. In the dark,|he was not afraid. He never had been.
lines.text: He pinched out his candle. In the dark, he was not afraid. He never had been.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Let go! He's lying! He's the one- let GO!
lines.text: Let go! He's lying! He's the one- let GO!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Back! Out of the light! It eats you.
lines.text: Back! Out of the light! It eats you.
